'''Jek-Burz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] and former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. He served as a member on the [[Tribunal (Rishi)|Tribunal]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref> Jek-Burz was approached by advocates for the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] and asked to help establish the Feast on Rishi by speaking with the Tribunal in favor of allowing it on-world. Jek-Burz agreed to help if the advocates helped him out, and gave them a choice of tasks to complete.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay Alternatives===
Jek-Burz will offer the player character two choices when gaining his vote for establishing the Feast on Rishi. Either the player must sneak into the [[Blaster's Path]] [[Cantina]] and steal him a bottle of [[Corellian wine/Legends|Corellian wine]], or the player goes and eliminates a group of [[Nova Blades]] who have not accepted the lawful approach of the [[Tribunal (Rishi)|Rishi Tribunal]].<ref name="TOR" />

Regardless of option chosen, once it has been completed Jek-Burz will vote towards allowing the Feast of Prosperity onto Rishi.
